exploit_name: Improper error handling of onClaim callback allows batch claim DoS or bypass
description: Try/catch block only wraps the onClaim() external call, not subsequent validation logic. Invalid return values trigger uncaught reverts, while actual call failures are silently suppressed.
root_cause: Try/catch block only wraps the onClaim() external call, not subsequent validation logic. Invalid return values trigger uncaught reverts, while actual call failures are silently suppressed.
fix_description: Restructure error handling to catch both external call failures and validation errors within single scope.
notes: Malicious recipient can abort entire claim batch, or bypass post-claim logic by causing a suppressed revert.
